character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A lean green-skinned goblin hooker, long pointed ears, wild grin, brass goggles on its forehead. Holds a heavy iron grappling hook on a long iron chain, the chain coiled over its left hand and shoulder, the hook in its right hand ready to throw. Patched brown leathers, a deep blue academy cloth sash with a gold star worn as a trophy, leather wraps on its shins, bare clawed feet. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brown leather, dark iron, brass, deep blue cloth. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.
